title: Carry-graded box convolution removes exponential axis-padding overhead
body:
Replaces independent-axis padding in the recentered tensor experiment with a mixed-radix carry grade. A D-dimensional box with N entries uses four signed integer products, each occupying fewer than 4DN coefficient slots. For the previous counterfamily this changes the padding factor from exponential in D to below 4D.

The package contains the general carry proof, executable packing/extraction, signed and unequal-radix cases, independent oracles, and the earlier exact rational weighted fixtures. Rank-filtered convolution has established precedents, cited in SOURCE.json; no originality claim is made.

Validation: fresh macOS Python 3.11/3.14 and Linux Python 3.14 runs produce byte-identical complete results. They execute 2,040 integer products, check 37,205 carry identities, reject 28,799 invalid flattened aliases and five arithmetic mutants. Four package controls reject optimization mode or input-integrity failures before output creation. Exact upstream source bytes are pinned and checked.

No new κ or runtime improvement is claimed. The residual dimension factor, transcendental table construction, packing/routing costs, tile interactions, Schur boundaries and outer constraints remain unpaid. The weighted fixtures are exact rational analogues, not all-size Gaussian instances.

Prepared by chafreaky with OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
